name: CandidateCard
description: Candidate summary card for list views. Shows avatar, name, headline, key info rows (location, salary, experience), status chips, and action buttons. Uses Shadow/Smooth for card elevation.

hoverActions.description: Reveal #actions on hover/focus only. Off by default: opacity:0 leaves a clickable, tab-focusable control nobody can see.

info-rows.note: Array of InfoBlock rows (location, salary, etc.)

actions.note: Action buttons. VISIBLE by default; opt in to the hover-reveal density with the `hoverActions` modifier. Never ship an invisible-but-focusable control.

usage.notes: Render in a grid or list inside the candidates DataTable or Panel body.

do: Show the most critical info upfront (name, headline, status).
Keep the primary action visible; use hoverActions only in dense grids where the noise is real.
dont: Don't show more than 5 info rows in the card body.
Don't hide an action with opacity alone — it stays clickable and tab-focusable while invisible.
